sources.role: per-platform paths, overrides and portable mode

paths.path: ~/.config/amiberry/amiberry.conf; per-machine .uae configurations default to ~/Amiberry/conf. AMIBERRY_CONFIG_DIR and AMIBERRY_HOME_DIR override these roots.
evidence: docs:BlitterStudio/amiberry wiki Paths-and-Files (Linux config and home roots)

paths.path: ~/Amiberry/controllers (or configured controllers_path), containing SDL gamecontrollerdb.txt and user controller mappings; .uae config files also carry per-machine input settings.
paths.naming: SDL gamecontroller database grammar (GUID, name, platform and button/axis bindings) plus Amiga key names in the .uae configuration; GUI-generated mappings are authoritative.
evidence: docs:BlitterStudio/amiberry wiki GUI: Paths (controllers default and gamecontrollerdb.txt)

paths.path: Configured saveimage_dir (default is the mounted Amiga volume/disk image for game data); CDTV/CD32 NVRAM is in ~/.local/share/amiberry/nvram by default.
paths.naming: Game-defined files inside ADF/HDF/CD images; CDTV/CD32 NVRAM files are emulator-generated and use the title/device naming selected by Amiberry.

paths.path: ~/Amiberry/savestates by default (savestate_dir can override); --statefile loads a specified state or searches the configured directory.
paths.naming: *.uss save states, based on the loaded .uae configuration or floppy; GUI offers slots 0-14 and stores a screenshot preview alongside the state.
evidence: docs:BlitterStudio/amiberry wiki GUI-Savestates (15 slots and preview)

paths.path: ~/Amiberry/roms (rom_path; the Linux path table calls this roms) holds Amiga Kickstart ROMs. Kickstart selection is per emulated model/configuration.
paths.naming: Kickstart ROM filenames are user-supplied/ROM-set-specific; Amiberry documentation does not publish canonical checksums for every supported Kickstart. Cloanto-encrypted sets additionally use rom.key.
evidence: docs:BlitterStudio/amiberry wiki Quick-start (copy Kickstart ROM files to roms)

paths.path: ~/Amiberry/roms/rom.key only when using Cloanto-encrypted Kickstart ROMs; ordinary licensed/plain ROMs need no separate key.
paths.naming: Exact key filename is rom.key; Amiberry does not publish a canonical checksum for user key files.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/com.blitterstudio.amiberry/config/amiberry/amiberry.conf; managed content is under the Flatpak XDG data/home roots and can be changed with Amiberry's Paths panel.
Flatpak Amiberry controllers directory (configured controllers_path, normally under the per-app data root) with SDL gamecontrollerdb.txt and GUI-generated controller mappings.
paths.naming: SDL gamecontroller database plus .uae input settings; exact names follow the upstream controller grammar.

paths.path: Game saves remain inside mounted Amiga disk images; CDTV/CD32 NVRAM and configured saveimage_dir are in the Flatpak writable data root.
paths.naming: Game-defined files in disk images; emulator-generated NVRAM names are title/device-specific.

paths.path: Flatpak data-root Savestates directory (the configured savestate_dir; default folder is Savestates in managed layouts).
paths.naming: *.uss, with 15 numbered GUI slots and screenshot previews.

paths.path: Flatpak writable ROMs/Roms directory as shown by the Paths panel; Kickstart ROMs are selected there.
paths.naming: Kickstart names are ROM-set-specific; no universal canonical checksum. Encrypted Cloanto sets use rom.key.

paths.path: The optional Cloanto key is rom.key alongside the Kickstart ROMs in the frontend/system or Amiberry ROM path.
paths.naming: rom.key; no canonical checksum published.

paths.path: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Amiberry\amiberry.conf; .uae configurations default to %USERPROFILE%\Amiberry\Configurations. Official portable ZIP mode uses <portable-root>\Settings and <portable-root>\conf when amiberry.portable is beside Amiberry.exe.
evidence: docs:Amiberry Paths-and-Files (Windows and portable ZIP table)

paths.path: %USERPROFILE%\Amiberry\Controllers (portable: <portable-root>\Controllers), with SDL gamecontrollerdb.txt and custom mappings; .uae files store machine input settings.
paths.naming: SDL gamecontroller database grammar and upstream .uae key/input properties; use GUI-generated files rather than inventing numeric bindings.

paths.path: Game saves are inside attached Amiga disk images; CDTV/CD32 NVRAM defaults to %USERPROFILE%\Amiberry\Nvram (portable: <portable-root>\Nvram).
paths.naming: Game-defined files inside disk images; NVRAM naming is title/device-specific.

paths.path: %USERPROFILE%\Amiberry\Savestates (portable: <portable-root>\Savestates).
paths.naming: *.uss, 15 GUI slots (0-14) plus screenshot preview; --statefile accepts an explicit file.

paths.path: %USERPROFILE%\Amiberry\Roms (portable: <portable-root>\Roms), selected as Kickstart ROMs for each Amiga model.
paths.naming: Kickstart filenames are ROM-set-specific; no universal canonical checksum. Cloanto sets may require rom.key.

paths.path: rom.key beside encrypted Cloanto Kickstart ROMs.
paths.naming: Exact filename rom.key; checksum not published by upstream.

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/Amiberry/amiberry.conf; .uae configurations default to ~/Documents/Amiberry/Configurations. AMIBERRY_HOME_DIR overrides the content root.
evidence: docs:Amiberry Paths-and-Files (macOS config/home table and legacy import)

paths.path: ~/Documents/Amiberry/Controllers with SDL gamecontrollerdb.txt and custom mappings; .uae configuration stores per-machine input values.
paths.naming: SDL gamecontroller database grammar plus upstream .uae input settings.

paths.path: Game saves remain within mounted Amiga disk images; CDTV/CD32 NVRAM defaults to ~/Documents/Amiberry/Nvram.
paths.naming: Game-defined files in disk images; NVRAM names are title/device-specific.

paths.path: ~/Documents/Amiberry/Savestates.
paths.naming: *.uss; GUI slots 0-14 and screenshot previews.

paths.path: ~/Documents/Amiberry/Roms for Kickstart ROMs; per-model selection is stored in the configuration.
paths.naming: Kickstart names are ROM-set-specific and have no universal upstream checksum; encrypted Cloanto sets use rom.key.

paths.path: rom.key alongside encrypted Kickstart ROMs.
paths.naming: rom.key; no canonical checksum published.
